plan.title: feat(swarm): cohort lifecycle - in-PR completion first, one cohort lifecycle PR (slice of #7062)

narratives.Description: Slice cohort-lifecycle of the accepted #7062 lean (comment 7082701528). In a cohort, a story that scope:complete --in-pr admits completes inside its product PR, and the parent, as cohort closer, completes the other merged stories in one swarm:finalize-cohort lifecycle PR with no changelog fragment. The closer passes only merged PRs, names and keeps every unmerged, omitted or refused story for a later run, and owns each story until verify:completed-tracked and verify:orphan-active pass. The preamble, AGENTS.md, the agents-entry template and the swarm and build skill sources say so; a solo story keeps today's worker-owned completion.
narratives.Overview:
- In-PR completion first. In a cohort, a worker whose story `scope:complete -- <active-path> --in-pr` admits (#6277) completes it in its product PR with the closing keyword that verb requires; that story needs no lifecycle PR. A worker whose story the verb refuses stops at product merge with `deft-story: N` and leaves completion to the cohort closer. A solo story keeps today's worker-owned completion.
- Cohort closer. The parent runs `swarm:finalize-cohort -- --pr <list>` with only the merged product PRs of post-merge stories, which opens one lifecycle PR with no changelog fragment (#680 / #6764). It reports each unmerged, omitted or refused story by id, keeps it on its list and finalizes it in a later run. It owns each story through lifecycle-PR merge, then runs `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` and `verify:orphan-active -- --issue N` for each.
- Lifecycle rule texts change together: the DONE reservation and completion rules in `content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md`, the cohort-closer carve-out in `content/templates/agents-entry.md` (DONE rule) and `AGENTS.md` (post-merge scope lifecycle), mirrored per #1309, and in `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json` (regenerated) the swarm skill and the build skill, whose swarm-cohort text sends post-merge completion to the cohort closer instead of a `scope:complete` after each story.
- Lifecycle tests: an admitted in-PR completion in a cohort opens no lifecycle PR; one `finalizeCohort` run over several `deft-story` PRs completes them in one PR with no fragment that passes `verify:changelog-unreleased`, #5656 scope-cover and closing-keywords; an unmerged PR left off the list stays active and is named in the report.
- A cohort story that `scope:complete --in-pr` admits completes in its product PR; the other merged stories complete in one `swarm:finalize-cohort` lifecycle PR with no changelog fragment that passes `verify:changelog-unreleased`, #5656 scope-cover and the closing-keywords check.
- The cohort closer passes only merged PRs, names every unmerged or refused story, and `verify:completed-tracked -- --issue N` and `verify:orphan-active -- --issue N` pass for every story it completes.
- The preamble, `AGENTS.md`, the agents-entry template and the swarm and build skill sources send a cohort's post-merge completion to the cohort closer, and a solo story keeps the unbatched path.
narratives.Constraint:
- Every cohort worker deferring completion to the closer when in-PR completion admits the story (comment 7082620305, finding 1).
- One shared cohort branch whose product PRs carry every peer brief and record pair, and a free-path rule for peer record pairs (comment 7082620305, findings 2 and 3).
- Full `deft-story: N` marks on a product PR for stories it does not deliver (comment 7082620305, finding 3).
- A cohort mint that shows only file paths, or reuses the one-file cohort runner without the approved-scope parser and pair builder (comment 7082620305, finding 5).
- Dropping the terminal mint for approved-scope (#7031), or folding #6284's allowance and expiry grant into this change.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running a cohort of stories, I want each eligible story to complete inside its product PR and the rest to complete in one cohort lifecycle PR, so that a cohort no longer costs one lifecycle PR per story.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort.ts (+ finalize-cohort-cli.ts): one run over several merged deft-story PRs completes them in one lifecycle PR with no changelog fragment; a story already completed in its product PR (in-PR) is a no-op and opens no PR; the report names each unmerged, omitted or refused story by id and leaves its brief active for a later run.
2. content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md: DONE reservation and completion rules send a cohort story's post-merge completion to the cohort closer after the worker tries scope:complete --in-pr; solo story unchanged.
3. content/templates/agents-entry.md (DONE rule) and AGENTS.md (post-merge scope lifecycle): cohort-closer carve-out, mirrored per #1309, then task agents:refresh.
4. content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json, then task packs:render (content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md, content/skills/deft-directive-build/SKILL.md) and the swarm references core-phase-0.md, core-phase-3.md, core-phase-5-6.md: swarm-cohort text uses in-PR completion first and the cohort closer, not scope:complete after each story.
5. Tests: packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-cohort-batch-7082.test.ts (lifecycle behaviour: in-PR no-op, one PR over several stories with no fragment passing the changelog, #5656 scope-cover and closing-keywords checks, unmerged PR named and kept active); packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/cohort_lifecycle_7082.test.ts (rule text in preamble, AGENTS.md, agents-entry and both skill sources). Regenerate docs/RULE-MAP.md and the evaluator-surface disposition if the gates ask. changelog.d/7082-cohort-lifecycle.md.
narratives.Traces: #7082 clauses 1-7 trace to the cohort-lifecycle slice of the accepted #7062 lean 7082701528: Bound remedy items 1, 2, 3 and 8 and Acceptance Criteria 1-3 (synthesis 7082734597, verified-claims table 7082732735).

metadata.issueBody:
Slice 1 of #7062 (build first). Scope is the `cohort-lifecycle` slice of the accepted lean on #7062 (comment 7082701528): in-PR completion first for cohort stories, one `swarm:finalize-cohort` lifecycle PR for the rest, and the preamble, agent rules and swarm/build skill text that send post-merge completion to the cohort closer.

Acceptance comes from the lean slice at ingest, not from this body.

Refs #7062
